visualReviewFocus: fry_bitterling: immature pigmentation revised; approve developmental proportions
sturgeon: scutes and barbels are reference-derived approximations
pleco: check flattened belly and dorsal-fin attachment
seahorse: curled-tail depth and upright silhouette
lionfish: complex fin rays are approximated
moray: head/jaw and unseen-side texture need human review; cave behaviour is not implemented here
sunfish: body disc and clavus thickness
marlin / halfbeak: bill dimensions and jaw line
goosefish / skate: dorsal contour and estimated underside
blobfish: living underwater anatomy, not collapsed form
frilled_shark: long-body profile and gill detail
